description.value: Red Barn Market is a locally owned grocery chain with eight locations across Greater Victoria and the Saanich Peninsula, founded at the West Saanich farm stand site in 2002 and built around Island-grown produce and locally sourced products. The Sandown location near Sidney includes a full sandwich bar and access to the chain's celebrated in-house Smokehouse line — including its famous Double Smoked Bacon and specialty sausages. Cyclists touring the Saanich Peninsula will find a well-stocked community market with a strong emphasis on local food producers.
